links.outcome: De-identification precision, recall, F1 and text loss across four prompting strategies on synthetic German letters
links.effect: Baseline unsuitable due to excessive text loss; F1 0.81 (session-isolated), 0.79 (structured-input), 0.93 (optimized prompt, GPT-4o), 0.90 (GPT-OSS).
links.quote: LLM-based de-identification is feasible but requires careful prompt design and validation on real-world data.

unlisted_practices: Prompt refinement outperforms structural preprocessing for LLM-based de-identification quality

screen.reason: Evaluates prompt design strategies (session-isolated, structured-input, optimized prompts) as safeguards/deployment practices for LLM-based clinical text de-identification.

primary.practice: prompt engineering / prompting strategies for clinical text de-identification
